reviews.author: Light9
reviews.text: Matt was fantastic. I have an unusual Chinese air conditioner. Not only did he understand what to do, he matched my drain to the colour scheme I had, was very friendly/ polite, efficient and I was relieved and appreciative of the pricing. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Britani Prestwood
reviews.text: Matt did such a good job fixing our evap in peak summer! Despite how busy he was he did his best to squeeze us in as soon as possible in the middle of a heat wave and we really appreciated the kind gesture. He was super prompt, professional & kind, would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Phil Stone
reviews.text:
Matt and his team came out and upgraded our ducting, vents and controller. The workmanship was professional, and they left everything clean and tidy. Our A/C has never worked better since the upgrade!

We’re extremely happy with the result and would definitely recommend Pro Vent Air Conditioning WA for any A/C work. Great service from start to finish!

reviews.author: joshua mills
reviews.text: Professional service, clean work. Very organized and efficient. Did great work and helped recommend and fix the old mistakes by a previous installer, can’t recommend them enough.
